AGRICULTURE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #8
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Poultry Rearing in a Fold.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Poultry Rearing in a Fold.

   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.

7. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

8. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)

   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

   B. Iron rusting
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning the Kitchen? (1 mark)

18. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

19. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

20. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal? (1 mark)

22. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids
